meta.title: 年轻人存不下钱，是因为缺了批判性思维
meta.title_en: Why Young People Can't Save Money

scenes.context: 讲者指出年轻人存不下钱的根因是缺乏批判性思维，并用广场绳索比喻营销的拉拽。
sentences: 国外所有的大学都要求大一学生必修这门课，而国内没有一个大学开设。
Every university abroad requires freshmen to take this course, yet no college in China offers it.
通识教育课：a general-education course
你站在广场的中间，身上每个方向都系着一根绳子，另一端拉在各个商家手里。
You stand in the middle of a square, ropes tied to you from every direction, each held by a merchant.
绳子拉在商家手里：strings pulled by merchants
你的认知被广告创造的情绪价值带跑了，多付了很多钱。
Ads hijack your mind with manufactured emotion, and you end up paying way too much.
情绪价值：manufactured emotion
paraphrase: Not saving isn't about earning too little.
你被绳子拉，不是你在选
scenes.speak: Every university abroad requires freshmen to take this course, yet no college in China offers it. You stand in the middle of a square, ropes tied to you from every direction, each held by a merchant. Ads hijack your mind with manufactured emotion, and you end up paying way too much.

scenes.context: 讲者点明批判性思维就是抵抗资本影响的思想免疫系统。
sentences: 这门课的主题，用容易听懂的人话讲：凡事都要仔细想想，是这样的吗？
The course's theme, in plain words: think twice about everything — is that really true?
是这样的吗：is that really true?
资本无形中影响着我们的三观，你的批判性思维就是抵抗影响的免疫系统。
Capital quietly shapes our worldview; your critical thinking is the immune system that fights back.
批判性思维：critical thinking
如果免疫系统足够强，从众攀比炫耀不会让你多掏出钱包。
With a strong immune system, peer pressure and showing off won't pry your wallet open.
多掏出钱包：pry open your wallet
paraphrase: 批判性思维 = 免疫系统
Critical thinking is your immune system.
scenes.speak: The course's theme, in plain words: think twice about everything — is that really true? Capital quietly shapes our worldview; your critical thinking is the immune system that fights back. With a strong immune system, peer pressure and showing off won't pry your wallet open.

scenes.title_en: Hourly-rate math and the hype bakery
scenes.context: 讲者用肉松小贝网红店排队案例和时薪算法教大家给消费的时间定价。
sentences: 上海人民广场开了一家卖肉松小贝的网红店，里三层外三层，据说要排一个小时。
A viral bakery selling meat-floss cakes opened at People's Square, drawing huge crowds with an hour-long wait.
网红店：a viral store
过了半年这家店不用排队了，再过了半年，这家店关门了。
Six months later it had no line; six more months and it closed down.
关门了：closed down
把税后工资除以22再除以7，算出的数字就是你的时薪，排队时把它算进蛋糕成本。
Divide your after-tax salary by 22, then by 7, and that's your hourly rate — count it into the cake's cost while you wait.
时薪：hourly rate
paraphrase: Waiting in line isn't free; you're paying with time.
Put a price on every minute.
scenes.speak: A viral bakery selling meat-floss cakes opened at People's Square, drawing huge crowds with an hour-long wait. Six months later it had no line; six more months and it closed down. Divide your after-tax salary by 22, then by 7, and that's your hourly rate — count it into the cake's cost while you wait.

practice: 表达「凡事想想是不是这样」
Think twice — is that really true?
Divide your after-tax salary by 22, then by 7.
表达「情绪价值带跑认知」
Ads hijack your mind with manufactured emotion.
Waiting in line costs more than you think.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The ads take away your cognition.
✓ 地道说法：Ads hijack your mind.
认知被带跑→hijack your mind 更地道。
✕ 直译腔：Divide your salary to calculate the time-money.
✓ 地道说法：That gives you your hourly rate.
✕ 直译腔：I want to know how delicious it is to queue an hour.
✓ 地道说法：What could be so good that people wait an hour?
表达「得有多好吃」用 what could be so good。
✕ 直译腔：Your immune system lets you not take out the wallet.
✓ 地道说法：It won't pry your wallet open.
不掏钱包→pry open your wallet。
shifts: 把时薪算进排队与溢价成本
把批判性思维当学者工具
把它当保护钱包的免疫系统
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「正门课」校正为「这门课」、「肉松小辈」校正为「肉松小贝」、「亲娘来」校正为感叹语气「得有多好吃」、「税后公司」校正为「税后工资」、「实行」校正为「时薪」、「一夜抱负的结晶」校正为「一夜暴富的捷径」、「意炫耀攀比」校正为「物欲炫耀攀比」。
